learned_patterns.pattern: INTC gapped from $139.50 (06-30) through its -12.6% stop and was sold at $109.01 on 07-07 for a -14.98% realized loss — a bigger loss than the stop level implies, because the fill gapped below the stop. This is the exact tail the ATR stop + fractional monitor are built to cap, and they fired correctly (agentic sell), but a between-session gap cannot be recovered, only exited. Reinforces the §13/§16 thesis: migrate single-name LAB risk toward lower-volatility ETFs (INTC's designated target is SOXX).

The Signal Engine has produced no fresh matrix since 2026-06-30 — an ~8-day outage, escalating from the earlier intermittent single-run misses. Every session in the gap ran (or would run) in SAFE MODE, so no signal-conditioned entry has been possible for over a week. Engine/workflow reliability, not signal quality, is the binding constraint on the book. Root-cause the GitHub Action (manual workflow_dispatch is required since the cron was removed — it must actually be fired before each session).

Two of two graded LAB exits are stop-outs (MRVL -5.71%, INTC -14.98%), both pre-engine baseline entries made with no signal gate. The signal-conditioned compound gate (§4.1) had not yet vetted either. The stop system works end-to-end; the open question is whether gate-vetted entries fare better — the first such grades are still pending (ARKK/NVDA), which is why LAB is measured vs QQQ, not on absolute win rate.

An involuntary exit (INTC stop-out) did the rebalancing that §17.3 forbids doing by force-sell: LAB fell 25.9% -> 17.9%, back under its 20% cap, without CLU trimming a winner. Organic exits, not discretionary sells, are how an over-cap tier normalizes. LAB now has one genuine slot of room for a high-conviction add once a fresh matrix arrives.

SOXX is -8.3% from entry on a semi pullback while it carries no stop (CORE, §13) — and that is by design. The same -8% on a single-name LAB position would likely have stopped out; the ETF sleeve absorbs the shock and keeps compounding. Confirms the §13.1 rationale that ETFs reduce false stop-outs and emergency sessions. No action taken on the drawdown.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null persist for every DRIP name, so the §15.3 dividend-growth screen stays unverifiable.
